seedAudit.purpose: Seed freshness audit; no outcomes, evaluation or full games executed.
seedAudit.scope: All repository benchmarks/**/*.json plus existing runtime *manifest*.json (excluding node_modules/.git), and retained Wingspan top-level checkpoints/results. Extract only integer values under seed/gameSeed/seeds, recursively; conservative union includes other games and seeded diagnostics if present.
limitations: This audit cannot certify unretained evidence or seeds encoded only in prose/source or under other property names.
Source SHA records identify the inspected bytes; live runtime checkpoints may subsequently advance.
Current study planned held-out seed banks are covered by its manifest, independent of whether outcomes exist.
Search RNG seeds are random-stream controls, not independent game deals; reused fixed mechanism fixture deals are intentional diagnostic reuse, never strength replicates.

ordinaryDiagnosticDeals.description: New ordinary position trajectories; full supported seed range audited, six used by default. Not strength outcomes.

fixedMechanismFixtureDeals.description: Intentionally reused existing 24 mechanism fixtures; excluded from freshness claims and from strength sample size.

diagnosticSearchRng.description: 940001+positionIndex*97+repeat*65537; up to48positions/10repeats. Not full-game deal seeds; reported separately.
